items.title: Flatness of the local ring map is etale local on the source and target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property of morphisms of germs given by flatness of the local ring map O_{S,s} -> O_{X,x} is etale local on the source-and-target (statement lines 8135-8143). The proof takes a diagram as in the local-source-target definition, producing a square of local homomorphisms of local rings, and shows that the vertical arrows are localisations of etale ring maps, hence essentially of finite presentation, flat, unramified and in particular faithfully flat; then flatness of the upper horizontal arrow descends to the lower one by the flat-permanence lemma with the indicated names, and conversely flatness of the lower arrow is propagated upwards in two displayed steps -- a base change and a localisation of a map between etale extensions (proof lines 8145-8182). The level is H3: the transfer is carried out in both directions with each ring-theoretic input named and the two intermediate ring maps written out.
